text:
Alex Wang: Quick sync — Helix POC kickoff. Need alignment on success criteria, sandbox access pattern, redaction approach, and pricing ask. Can folks drop availability for a short call?
Maria Ortiz: Available 10–11am PT tomorrow. For success criteria we should include: 1) 90th %ile latency under 500ms for 512 tokens, 2) end-to-end cost per 1k requests target, 3) quality baseline vs GPT-3.5 on our eval prompts.
Devon Blake: Re security: customer prefers VPC peering + S3 staging rather than uploading to hosted buckets. They also asked about completing the security questionnaire by EOD Friday. Who owns that?
Sean Patel: FYI pricing note — for a 4-week POC with 1k qps equivalent burst and ~500M tokens predicted, hosted API estimate is ~$12k; Dedicated reserved short-term dev pool estimate is ~$9k but requires minimums. I'll put both numbers in a sheet.
Katie Li: On redaction: propose we provide a redaction script that strips PII and replaces with tokens before ingest, plus a sample deck describing retention rules. Quick regex we use in prod: ```python
REDACT_PATTERNS = [r'\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b', r'\b\d{16}\b', r'(?i)\b(ssn|dob|email)\b']
```
Alex Wang: Good — Devon can you confirm whether Helix legal accepts VPC peering? If not we'll provide encrypted S3 signed-url workflow. Also Maria can you share the eval prompt set by EOD?
Maria Ortiz: Sharing evals now in the drive link: https://drive.redwood.example/helix/poc-evals (contains 120 prompts across docs/qa/summary tasks). We'll annotate which are MUST-pass vs exploratory.
Devon Blake: Legal said VPC peering is fine but needs IAM role audit and flow logs enabled. I'll open a ticket with eng-infra to enable flow logs on the test VPC.
Sean Patel: I uploaded a cost comparison sheet: https://sheets.redwood/helix/poc-costs — includes per-token, embedding batch, and estimate ranges for caching. Note: caching prefix could cut token cost by ~30% for our workload.
Katie Li: For sandbox data we recommend: (a) 10K synthetic docs + 50 redacted real samples, (b) S3 with lifecycle 30d, (c) access via temporary signed credentials. I'll attach a small sample payload and the redaction pipeline snippet.
Alex Wang: Can someone draft the POC success criteria row we can paste into the SOW? Minimal: 
- Throughput: sustain 200 rps with p95 < 600ms
- Quality: eval set pass-rate >= 85% vs baseline
- Security: data stored only in customer-owned S3, redacted samples validated
- Timeline: 4-week POC, week-by-week milestones
Maria Ortiz: Drafted and uploaded to the drive (see same folder). I added acceptance tests and eval scripts.
DeployBot: Sandbox provisioned: https://sandbox.redwood/helix/abc123 — creds sent via 1:1 to Helix infra admin.
Devon Blake: I created ENG ticket #ENG-4123 for VPC peering + flow logs. ETA 48 hours.
Sean Patel: Customer asked about SLA during POC. We should propose basic uptime target (99%) + support hours M-F. Will confirm with sales ops. :thumbsup:
Katie Li: Quick note on redaction QA: sample test harness runs locally: ```bash
python tests/run_redaction_tests.py --samples sample_set.json
```
Alex Wang: Excellent. Next steps: 1) Maria finalize evals (EOD), 2) Devon confirm VPC + ENG ticket (today), 3) Sean finalize pricing sheet and SLA language (tomorrow), 4) Katie prepare redaction artifacts and sample payloads (tomorrow AM). Meeting tentatively tomorrow 10:15am PT.
Maria Ortiz: Ack, will join and bring the eval pass/fail thresholds. :eyes:
Sean Patel: I'll have the pricing options ready.
Katie Li: Uploading redaction script and 50 redacted samples now.
Alex Wang: Thanks team — tagging Helix AE to pull into SOW once we have final items. :rocket:
